description: Implementation of BidirectionalStreamSpdyImpl class handling SPDY protocol stream operations, including data sending/receiving, stream management, and delegate notifications.

classes.name: BidirectionalStreamSpdyImpl
classes.description: Class implementing SPDY bidirectional stream operations, managing stream lifecycle, data transfer, and delegate notifications.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the SPDY bidirectional stream request.

methods.name: SendRequestHeaders
methods.description: Intended to send request headers automatically; not implemented here.

methods.name: ReadData
methods.description: Reads data from the stream into provided buffer, handling buffered data or pending reads.

methods.name: SendvData
methods.description: Sends multiple buffers over the stream, handling data coalescing and end-of-stream flag.

methods.name: GetProtocol
methods.description: Returns negotiated protocol (e.g., HTTP/2).

methods.name: GetTotalReceivedBytes
methods.description: Returns total bytes received over the stream.

methods.name: GetTotalSentBytes
methods.description: Returns total bytes sent over the stream.

methods.name: GetLoadTimingInfo
methods.description: Retrieves load timing information for the stream.

methods.name: PopulateNetErrorDetails
methods.description: Populates network error details; empty implementation.

methods.name: OnHeadersSent
methods.description: Callback when headers are sent; sets protocol and notifies delegate.

methods.name: OnEarlyHintsReceived
methods.description: Handles early hints headers; placeholder for future implementation.

methods.name: OnHeadersReceived
methods.description: Handles received response headers and notifies delegate.

methods.name: OnDataReceived
methods.description: Handles incoming data buffers, enqueuing them and scheduling buffered read.

methods.name: OnDataSent
methods.description: Callback when data has been sent; clears pending write state and notifies delegate.

methods.name: OnTrailers
methods.description: Handles received trailers headers and notifies delegate.

methods.name: OnClose
methods.description: Handles stream closure, updates state, error handling, and buffered read completion.

methods.name: CanGreaseFrameType
methods.description: Indicates whether frame type greasing is allowed; returns false.

methods.name: source_dependency
methods.description: Returns the source dependency for logging.

methods.name: SendRequestHeadersHelper
methods.description: Constructs and sends request headers over the stream.

methods.name: OnStreamInitialized
methods.description: Handles stream initialization result, sets delegate, and sends headers.

methods.name: NotifyError
methods.description: Handles error notification, resets stream, and informs delegate.

methods.name: ResetStream
methods.description: Resets and detaches the stream.

methods.name: ScheduleBufferedRead
methods.description: Schedules buffered read with a timer.

methods.name: DoBufferedRead
methods.description: Performs buffered read, handling data and delegate notification.

methods.name: ShouldWaitForMoreBufferedData
methods.description: Determines if more buffered data should be waited for.

methods.name: MaybeHandleStreamClosedInSendData
methods.description: Handles case where stream is closed during data send, or reports error.
